versions.content: If SOMEIPTransformationProps . sizeOf- StructLengthField is present for a struct the data type for the length field of the struct shall be determined by the value of SOMEIPTransformationProps . sizeOfStructLengthField : • uint8 if sizeOfStructLengthField equals 1 • uint16 if sizeOfStructLengthField equals 2 • uint32 if sizeOfStructLengthField equals 4 • Otherwise [SWS_SomeIpXf_00217] applies.
